PREQUALIFICATION CRITERIA The bidders shall upload following pre-qualification documents along with their offer as per mentioned in P ART-I of e-tender: 1. Bidder should submit the successfully completed similar works which in cludes NDT of Piping/ pressure vessels i.e thickness testing as per Factory Act. in Fertilizers/ Oil and Gas / Petroleum Refineries / Power sector/steel/

petrochemicals during last 7 years ending last day of month previous to t he one in which offers are invited/issued. Note :- a) Bidder shall submit executed work order/purchase order copy for fulfilling the above -mentioned criteria. This work order must be issued & executed in the last 07 (seven) years ending the last day of month previous to the one in which this subject tender is floated/issued. 2. Proof of execution of submitted work order, bidders have to submit the following document related to submitted work order (i) Completion Certificate/ Customer Acceptance Certificate OR (ii) GeM SDAC (Service Delivery Acceptance Certificate) document OR (iii) (a) Tax Invoice to the extent of the required Pre-Qualification value and (b) Proof of receipt of payment like bank statement for the above referred tax invoice 3. Vendor should appoint a DISH approved competent person to certify all insp ection, testing & certification jobs as per Factory’s Act, 1948 & Maharashtra F actories rules, 1963. Vendor shall submit copy of certificate of competent per son along with technical bid. 4. Being remote location and urgency of job, vendor having offices/branch offic es beyond 150 km (road distance) from Alibag will not be considered for eval uation. Vendor shall submit their office details along with technical bid. 5. Copy of partnership deed/proprietorship /Memorandum and article of association, certificate of incorporation. 6. Average annual financial turnover during the last three years, ending 31st March of the previous financial year (i.e. FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) should be at leas t Rs. 2.84 Lakhs. In case the date of constitution/incorporation of the bidder is less than three years old, the average annual financial turnover in respect of the completed financial yea rs after the date of constitution shall be taken into account. In this case, the financi al turnover during last financial year/ the average financial turnover during precedi ng two financial years should be at least Rs. 2.84 Lakhs. Bidders shall submit CA ce rtificate / CA audited Profit & Loss accounts, Balance sheets etc. indicating the ann ual turnover figures, in support of the same. The financial documents has to be CA audited/issued with membership number, seal, signed and with UDIN. 7. Copy PAN Details, GST Registration details, valid PF and ESIC registration details. .
